```{r}
library(pheatmap)
library(ggplot2)

# Read the KING matrix
# Read the genetic relationship matrix
rel_matrix <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/core_files/genetic_dist.rel", header=FALSE)

# Read sample IDs
rel_ids <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/core_files/genetic_dist.rel.id", header=FALSE)
sample_names <- rel_ids$V1 

# Add row and column names
rownames(rel_matrix) <- sample_names
colnames(rel_matrix) <- sample_names

# Convert relatedness to distance
reference_acc <- "6909"

# Get relatedness from reference to all others
relatedness_from_ref <- rel_matrix[reference_acc, ]
relatedness_from_ref <- as.data.frame(t(relatedness_from_ref))
relatedness_from_ref$acc <- rownames(relatedness_from_ref)
colnames(relatedness_from_ref) <- c("comp", "acc")
# Filter for CLOSE accessions (high relatedness)
close_accessions <- relatedness_from_ref[relatedness_from_ref$comp > 0.2,]

write.csv2(close_accessions, "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/core_files/close_accession.csv", quote = F, row.names = F)
```
